build_SPMTokenizer: build an SPMTokenizer instance from a SentencePiece model file and a list of supported languages
create_SPMTokenizer_encoder: create a token encoder for source or target mode with a specified language in SPMTokenizer
create_SPMTokenizer_raw_encoder: create a raw SentencePiece encoder without language-specific prefix or suffix tokens
create_SPMTokenizer_decoder: create a SentencePiece decoder from an SPMTokenizer instance
test_SPMTokenizer_lang_tok: test the _lang_tok_to_internal method that converts a language code to a __lang__ control symbol
